course_title: Community and Public Health Nutrition Practice

learning_outcomes.description: Apply key theories, frameworks and evidence related to community and public health nutrition in practice
Demonstrate the ability to plan, implement or evaluate community and public health nutrition programs
Apply quality management principles in a community and public health nutrition context
Apply a professional, ethically responsible and culturally safe approach to practice in a community and public health setting
Communicate effectively to diverse stakeholders, groups and communities

assessments.task_description: This assessment requires you to prepare for professional practice placement and set learning goals, including how you will achieve these goals. It is also an opportunity to review previous feedback and commit to acting on this feedback to improve practice.
assessments.deferral_or_extension: You cannot defer or apply for an extension for this assessment.
assessments.additional_info: You cannot defer or apply for an extension for this assessment.

assessments.task_description: You are required to self-evaluate your progress on placement at the end of week 2 (interim) and end of week 5 (final), using the form provided on ePortfolio. The form is based on the Dietitians Australia Competency Standards (Domain level) and the level of supervision you require. Your placement supervisor will complete the same form (interim and final) following your submission to assess your progress and developing independence on placement and provide written feedback.
assessments.submission_guidelines: Both the interim and final competency assessment are to be submitted via ePortfolio (submission link on Blackboard) to your placement supervisor and the final competency assessment and supervisor competency assessment will be submitted via TurnitIn.
assessments.deferral_or_extension: You cannot defer or apply for an extension for this assessment.
assessments.additional_info: You cannot defer or apply for an extension for this assessment.

assessments.task_description: Students in their placement pairs/groups will produce a 2-page Executive Summary and a Report (provided to the placement site). See Blackboard for details.
assessments.submission_guidelines: The Executive Summary and Report must be submitted via the relevant TurnitIn submission portal on the course Blackboard site. A copy of the Executive Summary and Report must also be submitted to Placement Supervisors. All students must submit a copy of the Executive Summary.

assessments.task_description: Students in their placement pairs/groups will deliver a presentation of their placement project. See Blackboard for details.
assessments.submission_guidelines: Your presentation slides must be submitted via Turnitin by all group members prior to the due date.
